questions.prompt: Which of these has exactly one endpoint?
questions.explanation: A ray starts at one endpoint and goes on forever in one direction. A line has no endpoints and a segment has two.

questions.prompt: Which of these can be measured with a ruler because it has two endpoints?
questions.explanation: A segment has two endpoints, so it has a length. A line and a ray go on forever.
135° is between 90° and 180°, so it is obtuse. Reflex angles are bigger than 180°.
250° is between 180° and 360°, so it is reflex. Obtuse angles stop at 180°.
A straight angle is a half turn, 180°. 90° is a right angle and 360° is a full turn.

options: An acute angle is smaller than 90°.
A reflex angle is smaller than 180°.
An obtuse angle is smaller than 90°.
questions.explanation: Acute means less than 90°. Obtuse is between 90° and 180°, and reflex is more than 180°.
